scriptLines: derivedColumn1 derive(department_c = case(startsWith(dept_l,'cardio'),'Cardiology', startsWith(dept_l,'onco'),'Oncology', startsWith(dept_l,'neuro') || startsWith(dept_l,'nuero'),'Neurology', startsWith(dept_l,'ortho'),'Orthopedics', dept_l=='er' || startsWith(dept_l,'emerg'),'Emergency', startsWith(dept_l,'ped') || startsWith(dept_l,'paed'),'Pediatrics', startsWith(dept_l,'gen'),'General Surgery', 'Unknown'),
discharge_date_c = iif(!isNull(discharge_date_d) && !isNull(admission_date_d) && discharge_date_d < admission_date_d, toDate(toString(null())), discharge_date_d)) ~> derivedColumn2
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM silver.billing','DELETE FROM silver.diagnoses','DELETE FROM silver.admissions'],
status_c = case(status_l=='paid','Paid', status_l=='unpaid','Unpaid', status_l=='pending','Pending', status_l=='overdue','Overdue', toString(null()))) ~> derivedColumn2
derivedColumn1 derive(gender_c = case(in(['m','male'], gender_l),'Male', in(['f','female'], gender_l),'Female', toString(null())),
dob_c = iif(!isNull(dob_d) && dob_d >= toDate('1900-01-01') && dob_d <= currentDate(), dob_d, toDate(toString(null()))),

insurance_c = case(startsWith(insurance_l,'medicaid'),'Medicaid', startsWith(insurance_l,'medicare'),'Medicare', startsWith(insurance_l,'cigna'),'Cigna', startsWith(insurance_l,'aetna'),'Aetna', startsWith(insurance_l,'bluecross'),'BlueCross', insurance_l=='uhc' || startsWith(insurance_l,'united'),'UnitedHealthcare', startsWith(insurance_l,'selfpay'),'Self Pay', toString(null()))) ~> derivedColumn2
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM silver.billing','DELETE FROM silver.diagnoses','DELETE FROM silver.admissions','DELETE FROM silver.patients'],

query: 'SELECT CAST(YEAR(f.d)*10000+MONTH(f.d)*100+DAY(f.d) AS INT) AS fecha_key, f.d AS fecha_completa, CAST(YEAR(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS anio, CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS trimestre, \'T\'+CAST(DATEPART(QUARTER,f.d) AS VARCHAR(1)) AS trimestre_nombre, CAST(MONTH(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS mes, CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),\'Enero\',\'Febrero\',\'Marzo\',\'Abril\',\'Mayo\',\'Junio\',\'Julio\',\'Agosto\',\'Septiembre\',\'Octubre\',\'Noviembre\',\'Diciembre\') AS mes_nombre, CHOOSE(MONTH(f.d),\'Ene\',\'Feb\',\'Mar\',\'Abr\',\'May\',\'Jun\',\'Jul\',\'Ago\',\'Sep\',\'Oct\',\'Nov\',\'Dic\') AS mes_corto, CAST(DATEPART(ISO_WEEK,f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS semana_anio, CAST(DAY(f.d) AS SMALLINT) AS dia_mes, CAST(w.dow AS SMALLINT) AS dia_semana, CHOOSE(w.dow,\'Lunes\',\'Martes\',\'Miércoles\',\'Jueves\',\'Viernes\',\'Sábado\',\'Domingo\') AS dia_nombre, CAST(CASE WHEN w.dow IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS BIT) AS es_fin_de_semana FROM (SELECT DATEADD(DAY, n.n, r.ini) AS d FROM (SELECT DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MIN(x)),1,1) AS ini, DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(MAX(x)),12,31) AS fin FROM (SELECT admission_date AS x FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT discharge_date FROM silver.admissions UNION ALL SELECT payment_date FROM silver.billing) u WHERE x IS NOT NULL) r CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP (DATEDIFF(DAY,r.ini,r.fin)+1) CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL))-1 AS INT) AS n FROM sys.all_objects a CROSS JOIN sys.all_objects b) n) f CROSS APPLY (SELECT (DATEDIFF(DAY,\'19000101\',f.d)%7)+1 AS dow) w',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_fecha'],

query: 'SELECT p.patient_id AS patient_id_bk, p.full_name AS nombre_completo, CASE p.gender WHEN \'Male\' THEN \'Masculino\' WHEN \'Female\' THEN \'Femenino\' ELSE \'Otro\' END AS genero, p.date_of_birth AS fecha_nacimiento, CASE WHEN a.edad IS NULL THEN \'Desconocido\' WHEN a.edad<=18 THEN \'0-18\' WHEN a.edad<=35 THEN \'19-35\' WHEN a.edad<=60 THEN \'36-60\' ELSE \'60+\' END AS rango_etario, p.email AS correo_electronico, p.address AS direccion, ISNULL(p.insurance_provider,\'Desconocido\') AS proveedor_seguro FROM silver.patients p CROSS APPLY (SELECT CASE WHEN p.date_of_birth IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()) - CASE WHEN DATEADD(YEAR,DATEDIFF(YEAR,p.date_of_birth,GETDATE()),p.date_of_birth)>CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END AS edad) a',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_paciente','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_paciente\', RESEED, 0)'],
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT department AS nombre_departamento FROM silver.admissions',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_departamento','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_departamento\', RESEED, 0)'],

query: 'SELECT \'N/D\' AS codigo_icd, \'Sin diagnóstico registrado\' AS descripcion_patologia, \'Desconocida\' AS nivel_severidad UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT icd_code, diagnosis_description, ISNULL(severity,\'Desconocida\') FROM silver.diagnoses',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_diagnostico','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_diagnostico\', RESEED, 0)'],
query: 'SELECT DISTINCT charge_type AS tipo_cargo, payment_status AS estado_pago FROM silver.billing',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DELETE FROM gold.dim_servicio_cargo','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.dim_servicio_cargo\', RESEED, 0)'],

query: 'SELECT a.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, dp.paciente_key, dd.departamento_key, COALESCE(dg.diagnostico_key, nd.diagnostico_key) AS diagnostico_key, (YEAR(a.admission_date)*10000+MONTH(a.admission_date)*100+DAY(a.admission_date)) AS fecha_ingreso_key, CASE WHEN a.discharge_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (YEAR(a.discharge_date)*10000+MONTH(a.discharge_date)*100+DAY(a.discharge_date)) END AS fecha_alta_key, a.attending_doctor_id AS medico_id, DATEDIFF(DAY,a.admission_date,a.discharge_date) AS dias_estancia, 1 AS conteo_admisiones FROM silver.admissions a JOIN gold.dim_paciente dp ON dp.patient_id_bk=a.patient_id JOIN gold.dim_departamento dd ON dd.nombre_departamento=a.department OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 d.icd_code, d.severity, d.diagnosis_description FROM silver.diagnoses d WHERE d.admission_id=a.admission_id ORDER BY CASE d.severity WHEN \'Critical\' THEN 4 WHEN \'Severe\' THEN 3 WHEN \'Moderate\' THEN 2 WHEN \'Mild\' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, d.diagnosis_id) dx LEFT JOIN gold.dim_diagnostico dg ON dg.codigo_icd=dx.icd_code AND dg.nivel_severidad=ISNULL(dx.severity,\'Desconocida\') AND ISNULL(dg.descripcion_patologia,\'\')=ISNULL(dx.diagnosis_description,\'\') CROSS JOIN (SELECT diagnostico_key FROM gold.dim_diagnostico WHERE codigo_icd=\'N/D\') nd',
preSQLs:['DELETE FROM gold.fact_facturacion','DELETE FROM gold.fact_admisiones','DBCC CHECKIDENT (\'gold.fact_admisiones\', RESEED, 0)'],

query: 'SELECT b.billing_id AS billing_id_bk, b.admission_id AS admission_id_bk, fa.paciente_key, fa.departamento_key, sc.servicio_cargo_key, CASE WHEN b.payment_date IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE (YEAR(b.payment_date)*10000+MONTH(b.payment_date)*100+DAY(b.payment_date)) END AS fecha_pago_key, b.amount AS monto_facturado, 1 AS conteo_transacciones FROM silver.billing b JOIN gold.fact_admisiones fa ON fa.admission_id_bk=b.admission_id JOIN gold.dim_servicio_cargo sc ON sc.tipo_cargo=b.charge_type AND sc.estado_pago=b.payment_status',
